title: Providers marked NotMaintained: Alibaba, Device42
remediation: Plan to move the stores named off their provider: upstream marks it NotMaintained (the store controller emits a warning event). Alibaba and Device42 are removed in 2.0.
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("alibaba") or has("device42")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) \(.spec.provider | keys | join(","))"'  # each row uses an unmaintained provider
